group.label: Catalog Storefront Document Store
group.comment: The document store keeps a ready-made copy of every product and category, so the storefront loads them much faster and without load on the database. Part of the GraphCommerce_CatalogStorefront modules.

field.label: Enable Storefront Indexing
field.comment: Keeps the copy up to date as the catalog changes. After a period with this off, a full reindex of the catalog feeds brings the copy up to date again. Another package that consumes the same feeds has its own setting.

field.label: Serve GraphQL From Documents
field.comment: The storefront API reads products and categories from the copy. A product that is not in the copy yet is read from the database.

field.label: Storefront Key
field.comment: Generated when this page is saved with the field empty. A request that sends it in the X-Catalog-Storefront-Key header may pick its path with the X-Catalog-Storefront header ("documents" or "core") and gets every fallback to the database reported in the response extensions. The API explorer and the parity gate send it.
